# One-Day Athlete Meal Plan
**Athlete Profile:** 178 cm, 85 kg | Goal: Muscle protein synthesis & recovery post-strength training

---

## DAILY NUTRITION TARGETS
- **Calories:** 3,000-3,200 kcal
- **Protein:** 170g (2g per kg bodyweight)
- **Carbs:** 375-400g (4.4-4.7g per kg)
- **Fat:** 85-95g (1g per kg)

---

## MEAL PLAN

### **BREAKFAST** (7:00 AM) | 650 kcal | 35g protein
- 3 whole eggs + 2 egg whites scrambled
- 1 cup oatmeal with berries
- 1 tbsp almond butter
- 1 banana
- Black coffee or green tea

---

### **MID-MORNING SNACK** (10:00 AM) | 320 kcal | 30g protein
- Greek yogurt (200g, 0% fat)
- 50g granola
- Honey drizzle (1 tbsp)

---

### **LUNCH** (1:00 PM) | 750 kcal | 45g protein
- 200g grilled chicken breast
- 1.5 cups brown rice
- Steamed broccoli (150g) with olive oil (1 tbsp)
- Side salad with light vinaigrette

---

### **PRE-WORKOUT** (3:30 PM) | 280 kcal | 10g protein
- Rice cakes (2) with 2 tbsp peanut butter
- 1 apple
- Water or sports drink

---

### **POST-WORKOUT** (5:00 PM - within 30 mins) | 450 kcal | 35g protein
- Protein shake: 40g whey protein, 70g dextrose/maltodextrin
- 1 large banana
- 8 oz low-fat milk

---

### **DINNER** (7:00 PM) | 700 kcal | 45g protein
- 220g lean beef or salmon
- 2 medium sweet potatoes (baked)
- Asparagus (150g) sautéed in 1 tsp olive oil
- Small side of mixed vegetables

---

### **EVENING SNACK** (9:00 PM) | 250 kcal | 25g protein
- Casein protein shake or Greek yogurt (200g)
- Almonds (30g)
- Berries

---

## HYDRATION
- **2.5-3L water** throughout day
- **400-600mL sports drink** during/post-workout
- Electrolyte replacement based on sweat rate

---

## KEY NOTES
✓ Protein distributed across 6 meals (25-45g each) for optimal MPS  
✓ Carbs prioritized around training window  
✓ Post-workout nutrition within 30 minutes of training  
✓ Micronutrient-rich foods (berries, leafy greens, sweet potatoes)  
✓ Adjust portions if actual weight gain/loss targets change
